description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing the 'Basic' theme extension within the OpenCart admin panel. It handles rendering the configuration page and saving settings for the theme.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for the Basic theme extension in the OpenCart admin area handling page rendering and settings updates.

methods.description: Render the theme configuration page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and current settings.
